info.title: FindyMail Universal API
info.description: FindyMail provides B2B data enrichment APIs for finding verified work emails, verifying email deliverability, finding phone numbers, enriching companies, finding employees, and reverse email lookup.

get.description: Retrieves company enrichment data from FindyMail.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Company domain to enrich, for example stripe.com.

schema.description: Company domain to enrich, for example stripe.com.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

get.description: Finds a verified email in FindyMail.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Full name of the person, for example John Doe.

schema.description: Full name of the person, for example John Doe.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Company domain, for example example.com.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

company.description: Company name returned for the contact.

company_city.description: Company city returned for the contact.

company_country.description: Company country returned for the contact.

company_region.description: Company region returned for the contact.

domain.description: Company domain returned for the contact.

email.description: Verified email address returned for the contact, or null when no email is found.

job_title.description: Job title returned for the contact.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn URL returned for the contact.

get.description: Finds contact details in FindyMail by email address.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to look up.

parameters.name: withProfile
parameters.description: When true, include full profile enrichment; this uses 2 credits instead of 1.

schema.description: When true, include full profile enrichment; this uses 2 credits instead of 1.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

companyName.description: Current company name returned when profile enrichment is requested and available.

fullName.description: Full name returned when profile enrichment is requested and available.

headline.description: Profile headline returned when profile enrichment is requested and available.

jobTitle.description: Current job title returned when profile enrichment is requested and available.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn URL found for the email address, or null when none is found.
